executions.differences_from_execution_2: All 39 arm x scenario replay metrics (terminal profit, max drawdown, Sharpe, turnover, costs, funding, trade counts) are bit-identical to execution 2. Differences: (a) it lacked the terminal-residual fields, run metadata and the per-scenario causality matrix; (b) its per-arm causality probe required pre-cut trades, so T1 (which does not trade before 2023-07-01) was marked invalid and the label was NO_WINNER. The rule change in (b) (a no-trade trial is judged on identical decisions and traces, as PR-C does for CASH) was made in the code while this execution was still running, before any T1-T8 result had been read; it was motivated by the trades requirement mislabelling low-turnover signals such as T3, and by a synthetic-test failure.
